Start from a category on the home screen.
Conversations are kept for 30 days unless you delete them.
Use AI help with your requests?
AI helps SmartCart understand what you type, ask about unclear items and build your cart. It suggests; it never orders, pays or changes anything without your approval.
What is sent: your message, with phone numbers, emails and card numbers removed, and which shopping apps you have.
What is not sent: your user ID, email, order history or location.
You can change this any time in Settings → Privacy.
